title: EXIST-Forschungstransfer
description: Federal support for research-based startups of high technical complexity with an existing proof of principle. Provides financial support alongside mentoring, access to university infrastructure and networking. A connection to a university or research institution is required.
summary: Federal funding for development-intensive, research-based startups. The programme page does not publish the funding amounts or the phase structure.
eligibility_text: Besonders entwicklungsintensive Gründungsvorhaben mit vorhandenem Proof of Principle und Anbindung an eine Hochschule oder Forschungseinrichtung.

eligibility_structured.label: Connection to a university or research institution
